patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
index 6562186..4fcfc40 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@ class RunPhase(StrEnum):
     TERMINATED = "terminated"
 
 
-FinalizationTrigger = Literal["turn_budget", "wall_clock"]
+FinalizationTrigger = Literal["turn_budget", "wall_clock", "environment_budget"]
 
 
 class ExecutorTurnStarted(StrictModel):
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..7b9a94c 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -880,6 +880,16 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
             triggers.append("turn_budget")
         if wall_time_remaining_sec <= wall_time_reserve_sec:
             triggers.append("wall_clock")
+        environment_calls_remaining = (
+            self._options.max_environment_calls - state.environment_call_count
+        )
+        # Work admission preserves these calls, but without finalization the
+        # executor can waste its remaining turns proposing inadmissible work.
+        if (
+            environment_calls_remaining
+            <= self._options.verification_environment_reserve
+        ):
+            triggers.append("environment_budget")
         if not triggers:
             return
         state.finalization_started = True
